strongestResult: The free improved Higgs response is a ray. A leading gauge-anomaly direction makes the fixed-energy matrix full rank but confines the family to a plane. Three pairwise distinct real projective source-amplitude ratios span H2(R), provided their weights are independently variable.

invariant.name: spectral innovation
properties: zero exactly for spectral collinearity on the declared support

ladder.disposition: positive innovation and rank two at overlapping energies, but fixed plane
full H2 iff a third distinct real projective source ratio has an independently variable weight

require a typed intertwiner; do not compare dimensions alone
